items.source: Uses of WebClient.ResponseSpec in org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client
items.translation: `WebClient.ResponseSpec` 接口在 `org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client` 包中的用法

items.source: Provides a reactive WebClient that builds on top of the org.springframework.http.client.reactive reactive HTTP adapter layer.
items.translation: 提供基于`org.springframework.http.client.reactive` 反应式 HTTP 适配器层的反应式WebClient。

items.source: Variant of WebClient.ResponseSpec.onStatus(Predicate, Function) that works with raw status code values.
items.translation: 与原始状态码值配合使用的 `WebClient.ResponseSpec.onStatus(Predicate, Function)` 变体。

items.source:
Provide a function to map specific error status codes to an error
signal to be propagated downstream instead of the response.
items.translation: 提供一个函数，将特定的错误状态码映射为向下游传播的错误信号，而不是响应。

items.source: Proceed to declare how to extract the response.
items.translation: 继续声明如何提取响应。
